typedef enum WEBP_CSP_MODE {
  MODE_RGB = 0,
  MODE_RGBA = 1,
  MODE_BGR = 2,
  MODE_BGRA = 3,
  MODE_ARGB = 4,
  MODE_RGBA_4444 = 5,
  MODE_RGB_565 = 6,
  // RGB-premultiplied transparent modes (alpha value is preserved)
  MODE_rgbA = 7,
  MODE_bgrA = 8,
  MODE_Argb = 9,
  MODE_rgbA_4444 = 10,
  // YUV modes must come after RGB ones.
  MODE_YUV = 11,
  MODE_YUVA = 12,  // yuv 4:2:0
  MODE_LAST = 13
} WEBP_CSP_MODE;
objects.description: Enumeration of output colorspace modes describing packing and channel semantics for decoded WebP samples. Used to select/describe buffer layout (RGB/BGR, with/without alpha, premultiplied variants, YUV/YUVA).
Holds parameters for a packed RGBA (or related) output view: base pointer, stride in bytes, and total buffer size. Used inside WebPDecBuffer union when colorspace is RGB-based.

objects.definition:
struct WebPYUVABuffer {    // view as YUVA
  uint8_t *y, *u, *v, *a;  // pointer to luma, chroma U/V, alpha samples
  int y_stride;            // luma stride
  int u_stride, v_stride;  // chroma strides
  int a_stride;            // alpha stride
  size_t y_size;           // luma plane size
  size_t u_size, v_size;   // chroma planes size
  size_t a_size;           // alpha-plane size
};
objects.description: Holds pointers, strides, and sizes for planar Y, U, V, and optional A planes for YUV(A) output. Used inside WebPDecBuffer union when colorspace is YUV/YUVA.

Generic output buffer descriptor for decoded samples. Contains output colorspace, dimensions, ownership policy (internal vs external memory), a union selecting RGBA or YUVA buffer params, and an internal allocation pointer when WebP manages memory.
Enumeration of decoder status/result codes returned by decoding APIs (OK, errors, suspended/incremental states).
Holds properties parsed from a WebP bitstream header: dimensions, alpha/animation presence, and encoding format. Populated by WebPGetFeatures().
Configuration flags and parameters controlling advanced decoding behavior: filtering, upsampling, cropping, scaling, threading, dithering, and vertical flip.
Top-level container bundling bitstream features, output buffer descriptor, and decoder options for advanced and incremental decoding APIs.
Opaque incremental decoder handle used to feed partial data and retrieve progressively decoded output. Actual struct definition is intentionally hidden; only a forward declaration is provided here.

Compression parameters used by the WebP encoder. Must be initialized with WebPConfigInit() or WebPConfigPreset() before use. Controls lossy/lossless mode, quality, speed, partitioning, filtering, threading, and various advanced options.

Main I/O and state structure for encoding. Holds input pixels (either YUV(A) or ARGB), output writer callback, optional stats, progress hook and internal buffers. Initialize with WebPPictureInit() and allocate buffers via WebPPictureAlloc() or import helpers.
Optional per-encode statistics populated when WebPPicture.stats is non-NULL. Contains size, PSNR, macroblock and segment info, and detailed lossless stats.
A helper sink for encoder output that accumulates compressed bytes in memory. Use with WebPMemoryWrite as the writer and manage lifetime with WebPMemoryWriterInit/WebPMemoryWriterClear.

functions.name: WebPMalloc
functions.signature: void* WebPMalloc(size_t size);
functions.description: Allocates size bytes of memory using libwebp's allocator. Returns NULL on allocation failure. The allocated memory must be released by calling WebPFree(). Intended for use with WebP APIs to ensure consistent allocation/deallocation.
requirements: Argument size is the number of bytes to allocate; no explicit minimum/maximum is documented.
The return value may be NULL on failure; callers must check for NULL before use.
Memory returned by WebPMalloc must be freed with WebPFree(), not free/delete or other deallocators.
The [[nodiscard]]-style contract (via WEBP_NODISCARD) indicates the return value should not be ignored; callers should handle allocation failure.
Do not use the pointer after it has been freed (no use-after-free).
Do not free the same pointer more than once (no double-free).

functions.name: WebPFree
functions.signature: void WebPFree(void* ptr);
functions.description: Deallocates memory obtained from WebP allocation/decoding routines. Specifically, it releases memory returned by WebPDecode*() functions (decode.h) and by WebPMalloc(). Use this to match allocations made by libwebp.
requirements: ptr must be a pointer previously returned by WebPMalloc() or by a WebPDecode*() function from libwebp.
The pointer must not have been freed already (no double-free).
The pointer must not be used after calling WebPFree() (no use-after-free).
Behavior when ptr is NULL is not documented here; callers should avoid passing NULL unless guaranteed to be accepted by the implementation.

functions.name: WebPDataInit
functions.signature: static WEBP_INLINE void WebPDataInit(WebPData* webp_data)
functions.description: Initializes a WebPData structure to default values (bytes = NULL, size = 0). Safe to call with a NULL pointer (no-op). Typical usage: call before first use of a WebPData or to reset a structure after clearing.
requirements: If webp_data is non-NULL, it must point to writable storage for a WebPData object.
Calling with a NULL pointer is allowed and has no effect.
After initialization, webp_data->bytes is NULL and webp_data->size is 0.

functions.name: WebPDataClear
functions.signature: static WEBP_INLINE void WebPDataClear(WebPData* webp_data)
functions.description: Releases the memory referenced by webp_data->bytes using WebPFree() and then re-initializes the structure to default values. Does not free the WebPData object itself. Safe to call with a NULL pointer (no-op).
requirements: If webp_data is non-NULL, it must point to a valid, writable WebPData object.
The memory referenced by webp_data->bytes must have been allocated with WebPMalloc() (or be NULL) so that freeing with WebPFree() is valid.
Safe to call on a zero-initialized or previously cleared WebPData (idempotent).
Calling with a NULL pointer is allowed and has no effect.

functions.name: WebPDataCopy
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE int WebPDataCopy(const WebPData* src, WebPData* dst)
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of src into dst. Allocates dst->bytes with WebPMalloc() and copies src->size bytes from src->bytes. Initializes dst to empty first. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure (including NULL arguments or allocation failure). On failure, dst is left initialized to empty.
requirements: Both src and dst must be non-NULL for the copy to succeed.
src and dst must not be the same object (no aliasing); passing the same pointer for src and dst will zero-initialize the structure before reading from it, leading to data loss.
If src->size is non-zero, src->bytes must point to a valid readable buffer of at least src->size bytes.
dst must point to a valid, writable WebPData object; any existing dst->bytes will be discarded because the function initializes dst before copying.
On success, dst->bytes is allocated with WebPMalloc(src->size); the caller is responsible for freeing it later via WebPDataClear() (or WebPFree on dst->bytes, then re-initialize).
The return value must be checked: 1 indicates success, 0 indicates failure. On failure, dst is initialized to empty (bytes = NULL, size = 0).

functions.name: WebPGetDecoderVersion
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN int WebPGetDecoderVersion(void);
functions.description: Returns the decoder library version packed as 0xMMmmrr (major, minor, revision). Useful for runtime compatibility checks and diagnostics.
requirements: No arguments; safe to call anytime.
Return value is a packed integer version; caller should not assume semantic versioning beyond the packing format.

functions.name: WebPGetInfo
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPGetInfo(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, int* width, int* height);
functions.description: Validates a WebP bitstream header and retrieves image width and height. Returns non-zero on success and zero on failure.
requirements: data must point to a WebP bitstream; valid pre-header chunk sequences include: RIFF+VP8(L), RIFF+VP8X+(optional)+VP8(L), ALPH+VP8 (internal only), VP8(L) (internal only).
data_size must be the exact size in bytes available at data.
width and height may be NULL if not needed; if non-NULL, they are set only on successful return.
Does not allocate memory and does not decode the full image.

functions.name: WebPDecodeRGBA
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeRGBA(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, int* width, int* height);
functions.description: Decodes an entire WebP image into a newly-allocated RGBA buffer with pixels in R,G,B,A order. Returns NULL on error. On success, width/height are set if non-NULL.
requirements: data must point to a complete WebP bitstream; data_size is its size in bytes.
Caller must free the returned buffer using WebPFree().
width and height may be NULL; when non-NULL, they are set only on success.

functions.name: WebPDecodeARGB
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeARGB(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, int* width, int* height);

requirements: data must point to a complete WebP bitstream; data_size is its size.
Caller must free the returned buffer with WebPFree().
width and height may be NULL; when non-NULL, they are set only on success.

functions.name: WebPDecodeBGRA
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeBGRA(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, int* width, int* height);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image into a newly-allocated BGRA buffer with pixels in B,G,R,A order. Returns NULL on error.
requirements: data must point to a complete WebP bitstream; data_size is its size.
Caller must free the returned buffer with WebPFree().
width and height may be NULL; when non-NULL, they are set only on success.

functions.name: WebPDecodeRGB
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeRGB(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, int* width, int* height);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image into a newly-allocated RGB buffer with pixels in R,G,B order. Any transparency in the bitstream is ignored. Returns NULL on error.
requirements: data must point to a complete WebP bitstream; data_size is its size.
Caller must free the returned buffer with WebPFree().
width and height may be NULL; when non-NULL, they are set only on success.
Alpha channel (if present) is discarded.

functions.name: WebPDecodeBGR
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeBGR(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, int* width, int* height);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image into a newly-allocated BGR buffer with pixels in B,G,R order. Any transparency is ignored. Returns NULL on error.
requirements: data must point to a complete WebP bitstream; data_size is its size.
Caller must free the returned buffer with WebPFree().
width and height may be NULL; when non-NULL, they are set only on success.
Alpha channel (if present) is discarded.

functions.name: WebPDecodeYUV
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeYUV(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, int* width, int* height, uint8_t** u, uint8_t** v, int* stride, int* uv_stride);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image into planar Y'UV (YCbCr 4:2:0) buffers. Returns a pointer to the Y (luma) buffer, and sets U and V pointers and strides. Returns NULL on error.
requirements: data must point to a complete WebP bitstream; data_size is its size.
u, v, stride, and uv_stride must be non-NULL; width/height may be NULL.
On success, U and V planes are sized to ((*width + 1) / 2) by ((*height + 1) / 2).
The returned Y buffer must be freed by the caller using WebPFree(). The U and V buffers must NOT be passed to WebPFree().
stride is the byte stride of the Y plane; uv_stride is the common byte stride of U and V.

functions.name: WebPDecodeRGBAInto
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeRGBAInto(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(output_buffer_size) output_buffer, size_t output_buffer_size, int output_stride);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image directly into a caller-supplied RGBA buffer (R,G,B,A). Returns output_buffer on success, or NULL if the buffer is too small or on error.
requirements: data must point to a complete WebP bitstream; data_size is its size.
output_buffer must be non-NULL and large enough; output_buffer_size must be at least output_stride × image height.
output_stride is the distance in bytes between consecutive rows.
On success, caller retains ownership of output_buffer (no free by library).

functions.name: WebPDecodeARGBInto
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeARGBInto(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(output_buffer_size) output_buffer, size_t output_buffer_size, int output_stride);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image directly into a caller-supplied ARGB buffer (A,R,G,B). Returns output_buffer on success or NULL on error/insufficient space.
requirements: data must point to a complete bitstream; data_size is its size.
output_buffer must be non-NULL and large enough; output_buffer_size ≥ output_stride × image height.
output_stride is in bytes between rows.

functions.name: WebPDecodeBGRAInto
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeBGRAInto(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(output_buffer_size) output_buffer, size_t output_buffer_size, int output_stride);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image into a caller-supplied BGRA buffer (B,G,R,A). Returns output_buffer on success, or NULL if the buffer is insufficient or on error.
requirements: data must point to a complete bitstream; data_size is its size.
output_buffer must be non-NULL and large enough; output_buffer_size ≥ output_stride × image height.
output_stride is in bytes between rows.

functions.name: WebPDecodeRGBInto
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeRGBInto(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(output_buffer_size) output_buffer, size_t output_buffer_size, int output_stride);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image into a caller-supplied RGB buffer (R,G,B). Any transparency is ignored. Returns output_buffer on success or NULL on error/insufficient space.
requirements: data must point to a complete bitstream; data_size is its size.
output_buffer must be non-NULL and large enough; output_buffer_size ≥ output_stride × image height.
output_stride is in bytes between rows.
Alpha channel (if present) is discarded.

functions.name: WebPDecodeBGRInto
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeBGRInto(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(output_buffer_size) output_buffer, size_t output_buffer_size, int output_stride);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image into a caller-supplied BGR buffer (B,G,R). Any transparency is ignored. Returns output_buffer on success or NULL on error/insufficient space.
requirements: data must point to a complete bitstream; data_size is its size.
output_buffer must be non-NULL and large enough; output_buffer_size ≥ output_stride × image height.
output_stride is in bytes between rows.
Alpha channel (if present) is discarded.

functions.name: WebPDecodeYUVInto
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPDecodeYUVInto(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(luma_size) luma, size_t luma_size, int luma_stride, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(u_size) u, size_t u_size, int u_stride, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(v_size) v, size_t v_size, int v_stride);
functions.description: Decodes a WebP image directly into pre-allocated Y, U, and V plane buffers. Returns the luma pointer on success, or NULL if an error occurs or any plane buffer is too small.
requirements: data must point to a complete bitstream; data_size is its size.
luma, u, and v must be non-NULL when supplying external planes.
luma_size, u_size, and v_size must be large enough for the decoded dimensions and provided strides.
luma_stride, u_stride, and v_stride specify byte strides for their planes.
On success, caller retains ownership of plane buffers; no library free is performed.

functions.name: WebPInitDecBufferInternal
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPInitDecBufferInternal(WebPDecBuffer*, int);
functions.description: Internal, version-checked initializer for a WebPDecBuffer. Returns non-zero on success, zero on ABI version mismatch.
requirements: First argument must be a valid pointer to a WebPDecBuffer to initialize.
Second argument must be the ABI version expected by the decoder (typically WEBP_DECODER_ABI_VERSION).
Caller should check the return value for success before using the buffer.

functions.name: WebPInitDecBuffer
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE int WebPInitDecBuffer(WebPDecBuffer* buffer);
functions.description: Inline convenience wrapper that initializes a WebPDecBuffer using the current WEBP_DECODER_ABI_VERSION. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: buffer must be a valid non-NULL pointer to a WebPDecBuffer structure.
Must be called before any other use of the buffer.
Caller must check the return value; false indicates version mismatch.

functions.name: WebPFreeDecBuffer
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN void WebPFreeDecBuffer(WebPDecBuffer* buffer);
functions.description: Frees any memory owned by a WebPDecBuffer. Does not free the buffer struct itself. Should be called last after decoding is done.
requirements: buffer must be a valid pointer to a WebPDecBuffer previously initialized.
Must be called to release internal memory; safe to call even when memory is external (per documentation comment in example for config.output).

functions.name: WebPINewDecoder
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN WebPIDecoder* WebPINewDecoder(WebPDecBuffer* output_buffer);
functions.description: Creates a new incremental decoder. Optionally binds it to an external output buffer; if NULL, a default internal buffer with MODE_RGB is used.
requirements: output_buffer may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must outlive the WebPIDecoder.

If output_buffer is supplied, the caller must not modify config except as allowed: only when output_buffer.is_external_memory != 0 may the RGBA/YUVA pointers, sizes, and strides be changed, and only within valid bounds. All other WebPDecBuffer fields must remain constant between calls.
Returns NULL if allocation fails; caller must check for NULL and call WebPIDelete() on success to release resources.

functions.name: WebPINewRGB
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN WebPIDecoder* WebPINewRGB(WEBP_CSP_MODE csp, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(output_buffer_size) output_buffer, size_t output_buffer_size, int output_stride);
functions.description: Creates and initializes an incremental decoder configured to output RGB(A) samples in the given colorspace into a preallocated buffer (if provided). If output_buffer is NULL, the library allocates it when decoding starts. Returns NULL on invalid parameters or allocation failure.
requirements: csp must be a valid WEBP_CSP_MODE corresponding to an RGB/RGBA-type output.
If output_buffer is non-NULL, output_buffer_size must be at least output_stride × image height and output_stride is in bytes between rows.
If output_buffer is NULL, the buffer will be auto-allocated using the selected colorspace; other parameters are ignored.
Caller must delete the decoder with WebPIDelete() when done.

functions.name: WebPINewYUVA
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN WebPIDecoder* WebPINewYUVA(uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(luma_size) luma, size_t luma_size, int luma_stride, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(u_size) u, size_t u_size, int u_stride, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(v_size) v, size_t v_size, int v_stride, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(a_size) a, size_t a_size, int a_stride);
functions.description: Creates and initializes an incremental decoder that outputs raw Y, U, V, and optional A planes. If luma is NULL, the output buffers are auto-allocated using MODE_YUVA when decoding starts. Returns NULL on invalid parameters or allocation failure.
requirements: If supplying external planes, luma, u, and v must be valid pointers; a may be NULL to ignore alpha.
Corresponding *_size values must be sufficient for the decoded dimensions and strides; *_stride values specify byte strides for each plane.
If luma is NULL, all parameters are ignored and buffers are allocated automatically.
Caller must delete the decoder with WebPIDelete() when done.

functions.name: WebPINewYUV
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN WebPIDecoder* WebPINewYUV(uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(luma_size) luma, size_t luma_size, int luma_stride, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(u_size) u, size_t u_size, int u_stride, uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(v_size) v, size_t v_size, int v_stride);
functions.description: Deprecated constructor like WebPINewYUVA but without alpha plane support. Kept for backward compatibility. Returns NULL on invalid parameters or allocation failure.
requirements: If supplying external planes, luma, u, and v must be valid pointers with sufficient sizes and correct strides.
If luma is NULL, buffers are allocated automatically when decoding starts and other parameters are ignored.
Caller must delete the decoder with WebPIDelete() when done.

functions.name: WebPIDelete
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN void WebPIDelete(WebPIDecoder* idec);
functions.description: Deletes an incremental decoder and frees associated resources. Must be called if any of WebPINewDecoder/WebPINewRGB/WebPINewYUV(A) succeeded.
requirements: idec must be a decoder returned by WebPINewDecoder/WebPINewRGB/WebPINewYUV/WebPINewYUVA/WebPIDecode, or NULL (no-op behavior is typical but not explicitly stated).
Must be called once to release resources; do not use idec after deletion.

functions.name: WebPIAppend
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN VP8StatusCode WebPIAppend(WebPIDecoder* idec, const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size);
functions.description: Copies and decodes the next chunk of available data into the incremental decoder. Returns VP8_STATUS_OK when decoding completed, VP8_STATUS_SUSPENDED when more data is needed, or another error status.
requirements: idec must be a valid incremental decoder.
data must point to additional WebP bitstream bytes; data_size is their size.
Caller must handle return codes: OK (finished), SUSPENDED (supply more data), or error.
Do not modify the decoder’s bound output buffer except as allowed for external memory as described under WebPINewDecoder.

functions.name: WebPIUpdate
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN VP8StatusCode WebPIUpdate(WebPIDecoder* idec, const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size);
functions.description: Like WebPIAppend but does not copy the provided buffer when the data starts at the bitstream beginning. Suitable when the data buffer itself is being extended/reallocated. Returns status as in WebPIAppend.
requirements: idec must be a valid incremental decoder.
data must contain partial data from the beginning of the bitstream; data_size is its current size.
The data pointer value may change between calls (e.g., if the buffer is resized); the function supports this use-case.
Caller must handle return codes as with WebPIAppend.

functions.name: WebPIDecGetRGB
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPIDecGetRGB(const WebPIDecoder* idec, int* last_y, int* width, int* height, int* stride);
functions.description: Retrieves the partially or fully decoded RGB(A) image from an incremental decoder. Returns the pixel buffer pointer, or NULL if output is not initialized yet. The format matches the colorspace set at creation.
requirements: idec must be a valid incremental decoder created with WebPINewDecoder or WebPINewRGB.
last_y, width, height, and stride may be NULL individually; when non-NULL, their values are only valid if the function returns non-NULL.
Caller must not free or modify the returned internal buffer directly; its lifetime is tied to the decoder.

functions.name: WebPIDecGetYUVA
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN uint8_t* WebPIDecGetYUVA(const WebPIDecoder* idec, int* last_y, uint8_t** u, uint8_t** v, uint8_t** a, int* width, int* height, int* stride, int* uv_stride, int* a_stride);
functions.description: Retrieves the partially or fully decoded YUVA image from an incremental decoder. Returns the Y (luma) plane pointer, or NULL on error. If no alpha is present, *a is set to NULL.
requirements: idec must be a valid incremental decoder created with WebPINewDecoder/WebPINewYUVA/WebPINewYUV.
Pointers last_y, u, v, a, width, height, stride, uv_stride, a_stride may be NULL when information is not needed; returned values are valid only if return is non-NULL.
Returned pointers refer to internal memory owned by the decoder; do not free or modify.

functions.name: WebPIDecGetYUV
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE uint8_t* WebPIDecGetYUV(const WebPIDecoder* idec, int* last_y, uint8_t** u, uint8_t** v, int* width, int* height, int* stride, int* uv_stride);
functions.description: Deprecated inline helper that calls WebPIDecGetYUVA while ignoring the alpha plane. Returns the Y plane pointer, or NULL on error.
requirements: idec must be a valid incremental decoder.
u, v, width, height, stride, uv_stride may be NULL if not needed; values are valid only on non-NULL return.
Alpha information (if present) is ignored.

functions.name: WebPIDecodedArea
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN const WebPDecBuffer* WebPIDecodedArea(const WebPIDecoder* idec, int* left, int* top, int* width, int* height);
functions.description: Provides information about the currently displayable (decoded) rectangular area during incremental decoding. Returns a read-only internal WebPDecBuffer pointer, or NULL if the decoder state is invalid.
requirements: idec must be a valid incremental decoder.
left, top, width, height may be NULL; when non-NULL, they are filled with the visible rectangle on success.
The returned WebPDecBuffer pointer is read-only, tied to the decoder’s lifespan, and must not be modified.

functions.name: WebPGetFeaturesInternal
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN VP8StatusCode WebPGetFeaturesInternal(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size), size_t data_size, WebPBitstreamFeatures*, int);
functions.description: Internal, version-checked entry point to parse a WebP bitstream header and populate WebPBitstreamFeatures. Returns VP8_STATUS_OK on success, VP8_STATUS_NOT_ENOUGH_DATA if more data is needed, or an error code otherwise.
requirements: First argument must point to WebP bitstream data; data_size is its size in bytes.
Third argument must be a valid pointer to WebPBitstreamFeatures to receive results.
Fourth argument must be the expected decoder ABI version (typically WEBP_DECODER_ABI_VERSION).
Accepted pre-header chunk sequences are: RIFF+VP8(L), RIFF+VP8X+(optional)+VP8(L), ALPH+VP8 (internal only), VP8(L) (internal only).

functions.name: WebPGetFeatures
functions.signature: static WEBP_INLINE VP8StatusCode WebPGetFeatures(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, WebPBitstreamFeatures* features);
functions.description: Inline public wrapper around WebPGetFeaturesInternal that fills WebPBitstreamFeatures from a WebP bitstream. Returns VP8_STATUS_OK on success, VP8_STATUS_NOT_ENOUGH_DATA when headers are incomplete, or an error otherwise.
requirements: data must point to WebP bitstream data; data_size is its size.
features must be a valid non-NULL pointer to a WebPBitstreamFeatures struct to be filled.
Returns a VP8StatusCode that must be checked by the caller.
Recognizes the same valid chunk sequences as documented.

functions.name: WebPInitDecoderConfigInternal
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPInitDecoderConfigInternal(WebPDecoderConfig*, int);
functions.description: Internal, version-checked initializer for WebPDecoderConfig. Returns non-zero on success, zero on version mismatch.
requirements: First argument must be a valid pointer to a WebPDecoderConfig to initialize.
Second argument must be the expected ABI version (WEBP_DECODER_ABI_VERSION).
Caller must check the return value before using the config.

functions.name: WebPInitDecoderConfig
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE int WebPInitDecoderConfig(WebPDecoderConfig* config);
functions.description: Inline convenience wrapper that initializes a WebPDecoderConfig using the current WEBP_DECODER_ABI_VERSION. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: config must be a valid non-NULL pointer to a WebPDecoderConfig.
Must be called before use unless WebPGetFeatures() is called first as per comments.
Caller must check the return value; false indicates version mismatch.

functions.name: WebPValidateDecoderConfig
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPValidateDecoderConfig(const WebPDecoderConfig* config);
functions.description: Validates that a WebPDecoderConfig is non-NULL and that all contained parameters are within valid ranges. Returns non-zero if valid.
requirements: config must be a pointer to a WebPDecoderConfig; function returns false if config is NULL or invalid.
Caller should check return value before decoding with this configuration.

functions.name: WebPIDecode
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN WebPIDecoder* WebPIDecode(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, WebPDecoderConfig* config);
functions.description: Creates an incremental decoder using the provided configuration and optionally initial data. If data is non-NULL, features are parsed into config->input. Returns NULL on error (and config->status, if available, reflects the error).
requirements: data may be NULL (no initial parsing) or point to a WebP bitstream; data_size is its size.
config may be NULL to use a default configuration; if non-NULL, it must outlive the returned decoder as references to its fields are used and no internal copy is made.
Caller must delete the decoder with WebPIDelete() when done.

functions.name: WebPDecode
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN VP8StatusCode WebPDecode(const uint8_t* WEBP_COUNTED_BY(data_size) data, size_t data_size, WebPDecoderConfig* config);
functions.description: Non-incremental decoding of a full WebP bitstream according to the supplied configuration. Returns a VP8StatusCode (VP8_STATUS_OK on success). The decoded image is written into config->output.
requirements: data must point to the complete WebP bitstream; data_size is its size.
config must be non-NULL and properly initialized (e.g., via WebPInitDecoderConfig).
Caller must check the returned VP8StatusCode for success or failure.
After success, any internally allocated memory in config.output must be released with WebPFreeDecBuffer(&config.output).

functions.name: WebPGetEncoderVersion
functions.signature: int WebPGetEncoderVersion(void);
functions.description: Returns the encoder library version packed as 0xMMmmpp (major/minor/patch). Useful for runtime feature checks or diagnostics.
requirements: No arguments required.
Safe to call at any time; thread-safe by design of typical version getters (state-free).

functions.name: WebPEncodeRGB
functions.signature: size_t WebPEncodeRGB(const uint8_t* rgb, int width, int height, int stride, float quality_factor, uint8_t** output);
functions.description: One-shot lossy encoder for 24-bit RGB input. Compresses the image using default encoder settings at the given quality_factor and returns the size of the encoded WebP bitstream in bytes. On success, *output points to a heap buffer containing the encoded data; the caller must free it with WebPFree().
requirements: rgb must point to a buffer of at least height * stride bytes containing packed RGB pixels.
width and height must be positive and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
stride must be >= width * 3 (bytes).
quality_factor is in [0..100] where 0 is lowest quality/smallest size and 100 is highest quality/largest size.
output must be non-NULL and *output will be set to a newly-allocated buffer on success; caller must release it via WebPFree(*output).
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPEncodeBGR
functions.signature: size_t WebPEncodeBGR(const uint8_t* bgr, int width, int height, int stride, float quality_factor, uint8_t** output);
functions.description: One-shot lossy encoder for 24-bit BGR input. Same behavior as WebPEncodeRGB but expects pixels in BGR byte order.
requirements: bgr must point to at least height * stride bytes with packed BGR pixels.
width and height must be positive and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
stride must be >= width * 3 (bytes).
quality_factor in [0..100].
output must be non-NULL; on success, *output must be freed using WebPFree().
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPEncodeRGBA
functions.signature: size_t WebPEncodeRGBA(const uint8_t* rgba, int width, int height, int stride, float quality_factor, uint8_t** output);
functions.description: One-shot lossy encoder for 32-bit RGBA input. Compresses using default settings at the specified quality. Returns size in bytes and sets *output to a newly-allocated buffer to be freed by the caller with WebPFree().
requirements: rgba must point to at least height * stride bytes with packed RGBA pixels.
width and height must be positive and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
stride must be >= width * 4 (bytes).
quality_factor in [0..100].
output must be non-NULL; on success, free with WebPFree().
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPEncodeBGRA
functions.signature: size_t WebPEncodeBGRA(const uint8_t* bgra, int width, int height, int stride, float quality_factor, uint8_t** output);
functions.description: One-shot lossy encoder for 32-bit BGRA input. Same behavior as WebPEncodeRGBA but expects BGRA byte order.
requirements: bgra must point to at least height * stride bytes with packed BGRA pixels.
width and height must be positive and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
stride must be >= width * 4 (bytes).
quality_factor in [0..100].
output must be non-NULL; on success, free with WebPFree().
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPEncodeLosslessRGB
functions.signature: size_t WebPEncodeLosslessRGB(const uint8_t* rgb, int width, int height, int stride, uint8_t** output);
functions.description: One-shot lossless encoder for 24-bit RGB input using default lossless settings (exact disabled by default). Returns encoded size in bytes and sets *output to allocated data to be freed with WebPFree(). Note: RGB values under fully transparent pixels may be modified for better compression unless exact is explicitly enabled via the advanced API.
requirements: rgb must point to at least height * stride bytes with packed RGB pixels.
width and height must be positive and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
stride must be >= width * 3 (bytes).
output must be non-NULL; on success, free with WebPFree().
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPEncodeLosslessBGR
functions.signature: size_t WebPEncodeLosslessBGR(const uint8_t* bgr, int width, int height, int stride, uint8_t** output);
functions.description: One-shot lossless encoder for 24-bit BGR input. Same notes as WebPEncodeLosslessRGB regarding default lossless settings and exact handling.
requirements: bgr must point to at least height * stride bytes with packed BGR pixels.
width and height must be positive and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
stride must be >= width * 3 (bytes).
output must be non-NULL; on success, free with WebPFree().
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPEncodeLosslessRGBA
functions.signature: size_t WebPEncodeLosslessRGBA(const uint8_t* rgba, int width, int height, int stride, uint8_t** output);
functions.description: One-shot lossless encoder for 32-bit RGBA input using default lossless settings (exact disabled by default). Returns size and sets *output to allocated data to be freed with WebPFree().
requirements: rgba must point to at least height * stride bytes with packed RGBA pixels.
width and height must be positive and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
stride must be >= width * 4 (bytes).
output must be non-NULL; on success, free with WebPFree().
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPEncodeLosslessBGRA
functions.signature: size_t WebPEncodeLosslessBGRA(const uint8_t* bgra, int width, int height, int stride, uint8_t** output);
functions.description: One-shot lossless encoder for 32-bit BGRA input using default lossless settings (exact disabled by default). Returns size and sets *output to allocated data to be freed with WebPFree().
requirements: bgra must point to at least height * stride bytes with packed BGRA pixels.
width and height must be positive and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
stride must be >= width * 4 (bytes).
output must be non-NULL; on success, free with WebPFree().
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPConfigInitInternal
functions.signature: int WebPConfigInitInternal(WebPConfig* config, WebPPreset preset, float quality, int abi_version);
functions.description: Version-checked initializer for WebPConfig. Fills a WebPConfig with defaults or a preset and quality. Used internally and by inlined helpers to guard ABI compatibility.
requirements: config must be non-NULL and writable.
preset must be a valid WebPPreset enum value.
quality is a float (typ. 0..100 for lossy; affects effort for lossless).
abi_version must match WEBP_ENCODER_ABI_VERSION; function returns 0 (false) on mismatch.

functions.name: WebPConfigLosslessPreset
functions.signature: int WebPConfigLosslessPreset(WebPConfig* config, int level);
functions.description: Enables lossless mode and sets related parameters ('method', 'quality', 'lossless') according to the given efficiency level in [0..9]. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: config must be non-NULL and previously initialized (e.g., via WebPConfigInit or WebPConfigPreset).
level must be in the range 0 (fastest) to 9 (slowest/best); returns 0 on parameter error.

functions.name: WebPValidateConfig
functions.signature: int WebPValidateConfig(const WebPConfig* config);
functions.description: Validates that a WebPConfig pointer is non-NULL and that all fields are within valid ranges. Returns non-zero if valid, zero otherwise.
requirements: config must be non-NULL.
Call after setting fields in WebPConfig to ensure parameters are acceptable before encoding.

functions.name: WebPMemoryWriterInit
functions.signature: void WebPMemoryWriterInit(WebPMemoryWriter* writer);
functions.description: Initializes a WebPMemoryWriter structure for use with WebPMemoryWrite. Must be called before passing writer as picture->custom_ptr and using the memory writer.
requirements: writer must be non-NULL and writable.
Must be called before any use with WebPMemoryWrite.

functions.name: WebPMemoryWriterClear
functions.signature: void WebPMemoryWriterClear(WebPMemoryWriter* writer);
functions.description: Releases the memory buffer (writer->mem) allocated by WebPMemoryWrite. Does not free the writer object itself.
requirements: writer must be non-NULL.
Safe to call when writer->mem is NULL; after call, writer->mem is freed and sizes reset (implementation-specific).

functions.name: WebPMemoryWrite
functions.signature: int WebPMemoryWrite(const uint8_t* data, size_t data_size, const WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: A WebPWriterFunction implementation that appends encoded bytes to a growing memory buffer managed by a WebPMemoryWriter stored in picture->custom_ptr. On completion of an encode using this writer, writer->mem and writer->size contain the full bitstream. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and picture->custom_ptr must point to an initialized WebPMemoryWriter (initialized via WebPMemoryWriterInit).
data must be non-NULL, and data_size may be zero (appending nothing).
After encoding completes, the caller must free the accumulated buffer by calling WebPMemoryWriterClear(&writer).

functions.name: WebPPictureInitInternal
functions.signature: int WebPPictureInitInternal(WebPPicture* picture, int abi_version);
functions.description: Version-checked initializer for WebPPicture. Sets default values (use_argb=false, colorspace=WEBP_YUV420, etc.) and guards ABI compatibility. Used internally and via the inline WebPPictureInit helper.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and writable.
abi_version must match WEBP_ENCODER_ABI_VERSION; returns 0 on mismatch.
Must be called before using a WebPPicture with other API functions.

functions.name: WebPPictureAlloc
functions.signature: int WebPPictureAlloc(WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: Allocates Y/U/V (and A if needed) or ARGB image buffers based on picture->width/height and colorspace/use_argb. Frees any previous internal buffers first. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and initialized (via WebPPictureInit).
picture->width and picture->height must be set, positive, and <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
Returns 0 on memory allocation failure.

functions.name: WebPPictureFree
functions.signature: void WebPPictureFree(WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: Releases memory allocated by WebPPictureAlloc() or WebPPictureImport*(). Does not free the WebPPicture object itself. Other fields are preserved.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL.
Only frees internal pixel buffers owned by the picture; does not affect user-owned buffers that were never adopted by the picture.

functions.name: WebPPictureCopy
functions.signature: int WebPPictureCopy(const WebPPicture* src, WebPPicture* dst);
functions.description: Deep-copies the pixel data from src to dst, allocating buffers in dst as needed (dst will own the copy). dst need not be initialized as its content is overwritten. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: src and dst must be non-NULL.
src must be a valid, initialized WebPPicture with consistent dimensions and buffers.
Returns 0 on memory allocation error.

functions.name: WebPPlaneDistortion
functions.signature: int WebPPlaneDistortion(const uint8_t* src, size_t src_stride, const uint8_t* ref, size_t ref_stride, int width, int height, size_t x_step, int type, float* distortion, float* result);
functions.description: Computes distortion between two packed sample planes using PSNR, SSIM, or LSIM. Stores raw distortion in *distortion and a refined metric in *result. Returns non-zero on success. Intended for analysis and testing.
requirements: src and ref must be non-NULL and point to planes of at least height rows with the given strides.
width and height must be positive.
x_step is the horizontal byte step between consecutive samples (must be >=1 and consistent with stride).
src_stride and ref_stride must be >= width * x_step, and represent byte distance between rows.
type must be 0 (PSNR), 1 (SSIM), or 2 (LSIM).
distortion and result must be non-NULL.
Returns 0 on bad parameter or memory error.

functions.name: WebPPictureDistortion
functions.signature: int WebPPictureDistortion(const WebPPicture* src, const WebPPicture* ref, int metric_type, float result[5]);
functions.description: Computes PSNR, SSIM, or LSIM metrics between two pictures. Always operates on ARGB samples (converting YUV(A) internally if needed). Stores dB values in result[5] in the order B, G, R, A, All. CPU-intensive. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: src and ref must be non-NULL, valid WebPPicture objects of identical dimensions.
metric_type must be 0 (PSNR), 1 (SSIM), or 2 (LSIM).
result must be non-NULL and have room for 5 floats.
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPPictureCrop
functions.signature: int WebPPictureCrop(WebPPicture* picture, int left, int top, int width, int height);
functions.description: In-place crop of a picture to the rectangle [left, top, left+width, top+height). May reallocate buffers. For YUV420 sources, left and top are snapped to even values. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and valid/initialized.
The crop rectangle must be fully inside the current picture bounds; otherwise returns 0.
width and height must be positive.
Returns 0 on memory allocation error.
For YUV420 colorspace, left and top will be adjusted to even values (implicit).

functions.name: WebPPictureView
functions.signature: int WebPPictureView(const WebPPicture* src, int left, int top, int width, int height, WebPPicture* dst);
functions.description: Creates a view (shallow slice) of a rectangle from src into dst without copying pixels. The view references src's data; src must outlive dst. Self-view (src==dst) is allowed for fast cropping, but original dimensions are lost. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: src and dst must be non-NULL.
The rectangle [left, top, left+width, top+height) must be fully inside src.
If src uses YUV420, left and top will be snapped to even values.
When src==dst, the operation acts as in-place fast-crop; original full dimensions are not preserved.
If dst != src, dst need not be pre-initialized; its content will be overwritten.
Returns 0 on invalid parameters.

functions.name: WebPPictureIsView
functions.signature: int WebPPictureIsView(const WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: Returns non-zero if picture is a view (does not own its pixel memory), zero otherwise.
requirements: picture should be non-NULL.

functions.name: WebPPictureRescale
functions.signature: int WebPPictureRescale(WebPPicture* picture, int width, int height);
functions.description: Rescales a picture to the specified width and height. If exactly one of width or height is 0, the other dimension is computed to preserve aspect ratio. No gamma correction. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and valid/initialized.
If both width and height are non-zero, both must be positive; if one is zero, the other must be positive.
Returns 0 on invalid parameters or insufficient memory.

functions.name: WebPPictureImportRGB
functions.signature: int WebPPictureImportRGB(WebPPicture* picture, const uint8_t* rgb, int rgb_stride);
functions.description: Converts and imports packed 24-bit RGB samples into picture, allocating internal buffers as needed. Frees any previous internal buffer. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and initialized.
rgb must be non-NULL and point to at least picture->height * rgb_stride bytes.
rgb_stride must be >= picture->width * 3 (bytes).
Returns 0 on memory error.

functions.name: WebPPictureImportRGBA
functions.signature: int WebPPictureImportRGBA(WebPPicture* picture, const uint8_t* rgba, int rgba_stride);
functions.description: Converts and imports packed 32-bit RGBA samples into picture, allocating internal buffers as needed. Frees any previous internal buffer. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and initialized.
rgba must be non-NULL and point to at least picture->height * rgba_stride bytes.
rgba_stride must be >= picture->width * 4 (bytes).
Returns 0 on memory error.

functions.name: WebPPictureImportRGBX
functions.signature: int WebPPictureImportRGBX(WebPPicture* picture, const uint8_t* rgbx, int rgbx_stride);
functions.description: Imports 32-bit RGBX input by ignoring the alpha byte and treating input as RGB, avoiding an intermediate 24-bit copy. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and initialized.
rgbx must be non-NULL and point to at least picture->height * rgbx_stride bytes.
rgbx_stride must be >= picture->width * 4 (bytes).
Returns 0 on memory error.

functions.name: WebPPictureImportBGR
functions.signature: int WebPPictureImportBGR(WebPPicture* picture, const uint8_t* bgr, int bgr_stride);
functions.description: Imports packed 24-bit BGR samples into picture, allocating internal buffers as needed. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and initialized.
bgr must be non-NULL and point to at least picture->height * bgr_stride bytes.
bgr_stride must be >= picture->width * 3 (bytes).
Returns 0 on memory error.

functions.name: WebPPictureImportBGRA
functions.signature: int WebPPictureImportBGRA(WebPPicture* picture, const uint8_t* bgra, int bgra_stride);
functions.description: Imports packed 32-bit BGRA samples into picture. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and initialized.
bgra must be non-NULL and point to at least picture->height * bgra_stride bytes.
bgra_stride must be >= picture->width * 4 (bytes).
Returns 0 on memory error.

functions.name: WebPPictureImportBGRX
functions.signature: int WebPPictureImportBGRX(WebPPicture* picture, const uint8_t* bgrx, int bgrx_stride);
functions.description: Imports 32-bit BGRX input by ignoring the alpha byte and treating input as BGR, avoiding an intermediate 24-bit copy. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and initialized.
bgrx must be non-NULL and point to at least picture->height * bgrx_stride bytes.
bgrx_stride must be >= picture->width * 4 (bytes).
Returns 0 on memory error.

functions.name: WebPPictureARGBToYUVA
functions.signature: int WebPPictureARGBToYUVA(WebPPicture* picture, WebPEncCSP /*colorspace = WEBP_YUV420*/);
functions.description: Converts picture->argb to YUVA420 and sets use_argb=false. The colorspace parameter is deprecated and should be WEBP_YUV420. Detects presence of non-opaque alpha and adjusts colorspace accordingly. Conversion is lossy. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL, initialized, and contain valid ARGB data (use_argb should be true).
colorspace argument should be WEBP_YUV420 (deprecated); other values are not supported.
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPPictureARGBToYUVADithered
functions.signature: int WebPPictureARGBToYUVADithered(WebPPicture* picture, WebPEncCSP colorspace, float dithering);
functions.description: Like WebPPictureARGBToYUVA but applies pseudo-random dithering during conversion. dithering is in [0.0, 1.0], where 0 disables dithering and 1.0 is maximum. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL, initialized, and contain valid ARGB data.
colorspace should be WEBP_YUV420.
dithering should be in [0.0, 1.0].
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPPictureSharpARGBToYUVA
functions.signature: int WebPPictureSharpARGBToYUVA(WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: Performs higher-quality, slower ARGB->YUVA420 downsampling and conversion with special care for clipping, producing sharper YUV. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL, initialized, and contain valid ARGB data.
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPPictureSmartARGBToYUVA
functions.signature: int WebPPictureSmartARGBToYUVA(WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: Backward-compatibility alias for WebPPictureSharpARGBToYUVA. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL, initialized, and contain valid ARGB data.
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPPictureYUVAToARGB
functions.signature: int WebPPictureYUVAToARGB(WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: Converts YUV(A) input in picture to ARGB and sets use_argb=true. Accepted input formats are YUV_420 and YUV_420A. The conversion incurs a small loss. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL, initialized, and contain valid YUV_420 or YUV_420A data.
Returns 0 on error.

functions.name: WebPCleanupTransparentArea
functions.signature: void WebPCleanupTransparentArea(WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: For a picture with RGBA or YUVA samples, smooths/cleans RGB/YUV values under fully transparent pixels to improve compressibility. No return value.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and valid.
Intended for inputs with transparency; has no effect on fully opaque images.

functions.name: WebPPictureHasTransparency
functions.signature: int WebPPictureHasTransparency(const WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: Scans picture for any non-fully-opaque alpha values. Returns non-zero if any alpha < 0xFF is found, zero otherwise.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and valid.

functions.name: WebPBlendAlpha
functions.signature: void WebPBlendAlpha(WebPPicture* picture, uint32_t background_rgb);
functions.description: Removes transparency by compositing colors over the given 24-bit background_rgb (0x00RRGGBB). After blending, all alpha values are set to 0xFF.
requirements: picture must be non-NULL and valid.
background_rgb is a 24-bit RGB triplet packed in the low 24 bits of the uint32_t.

functions.name: WebPEncode
functions.signature: int WebPEncode(const WebPConfig* config, WebPPicture* picture);
functions.description: Main encoding entry point. Encodes the image described by picture according to config. Supports both YUV(A) (recommended for lossy) and ARGB (recommended for lossless). Returns non-zero on success and updates picture->error_code on failure.
requirements: config must be non-NULL, initialized (via WebPConfigInit/WebPConfigPreset or WebPConfigLosslessPreset), and pass WebPValidateConfig().
picture must be non-NULL, initialized via WebPPictureInit(), and describe an image with width and height <= WEBP_MAX_DIMENSION (16383).
picture->use_argb determines input interpretation: ARGB for lossless, YUV(A) for lossy. Automatic conversion may occur but can be lossy.
A writer must be provided (picture->writer) and configured (e.g., WebPMemoryWrite with a properly initialized WebPMemoryWriter), or equivalent output handling.
On failure, check picture->error_code for a WebPEncodingError value.

functions.name: WebPGetMuxVersion
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN int WebPGetMuxVersion(void);
functions.description: Returns the mux library version as a packed integer with 8 bits per major/minor/revision (e.g., 0x020507 for v2.5.7). Useful for runtime compatibility checks.
requirements: No arguments required.
Return value encodes version as 0xMMmmrr (hex).

functions.name: WebPNewInternal
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN WebPMux* WebPNewInternal(int);
functions.description: Internal, version-checked constructor for a new, empty WebPMux object. Use WebPMuxNew() instead unless you need to pass an explicit ABI version.
requirements: The integer parameter is an ABI/version token and must match WEBP_MUX_ABI_VERSION for success.
On success returns a new WebPMux*; returns NULL on memory error.

functions.name: WebPMuxNew
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE WebPMux* WebPMuxNew(void);
functions.description: Creates a new, empty WebPMux object using the current ABI version. Convenience wrapper over WebPNewInternal().
requirements: Returns a valid WebPMux* on success or NULL on memory allocation failure.
Caller is responsible for eventually calling WebPMuxDelete() on the returned object.

functions.name: WebPMuxDelete
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN void WebPMuxDelete(WebPMux* mux);
functions.description: Deletes and frees a WebPMux object and its owned resources.
requirements: mux may be NULL (no effect).
After calling, the mux pointer becomes invalid and must not be used.

functions.name: WebPMuxCreateInternal
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN WebPMux* WebPMuxCreateInternal(const WebPData*, int, int);
functions.description: Internal, version-checked constructor that parses WebP RIFF data and builds a WebPMux object. Prefer WebPMuxCreate().
requirements: First parameter is a pointer to WebPData containing a WebP RIFF bitstream; must not be NULL for success.
Second parameter copy_data: 1 to copy the data into the mux, 0 to reference it; if 0, the input data must outlive the mux.
Third parameter is ABI/version and must equal WEBP_MUX_ABI_VERSION.
Returns NULL on invalid data or memory error.

functions.name: WebPMuxCreate
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE WebPMux* WebPMuxCreate(const WebPData* bitstream, int copy_data);
functions.description: Creates a WebPMux object from WebP RIFF-formatted data.
requirements: bitstream must point to valid WebP RIFF data; must not be NULL for success.
copy_data = 1 to copy data into the mux; copy_data = 0 to keep a reference. If not copied, the source data must remain valid for the lifetime of the mux.
Returns NULL on invalid input or memory allocation failure.

functions.name: WebPMuxSetChunk
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxSetChunk(WebPMux* mux, const char fourcc[4], const WebPData* chunk_data, int copy_data);
functions.description: Adds or replaces a non-image chunk (e.g., ICCP, XMP, EXIF) in a WebPMux. Existing chunks with the same fourcc are removed first.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
fourcc must not be NULL and must refer to a non-image chunk (not "ANMF", "VP8 ", "VP8L", or "ALPH").
chunk_data must not be NULL and must contain the chunk payload.
copy_data = 1 to copy chunk bytes; copy_data = 0 to reference them. If not copied, chunk_data must remain valid until WebPMuxAssemble() is called.
Returns WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT if mux/fourcc/chunk_data is NULL or fourcc is an image chunk; WEBP_MUX_MEMORY_ERROR on allocation failure; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxGetChunk
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxGetChunk(const WebPMux* mux, const char fourcc[4], WebPData* chunk_data);
functions.description: Retrieves a reference to a non-image chunk's data by fourcc from the mux. The returned data is owned by the mux and must not be freed by the caller.
requirements: mux and fourcc must not be NULL.
chunk_data must not be NULL and will be filled on success.
fourcc must refer to a non-image chunk (not an image-related chunk).
Returns WEBP_MUX_NOT_FOUND if the chunk is absent; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxDeleteChunk
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxDeleteChunk(WebPMux* mux, const char fourcc[4]);
functions.description: Deletes a non-image chunk by fourcc from the mux.
requirements: mux and fourcc must not be NULL.
fourcc must refer to a non-image chunk (image chunks are not managed via this API).
Returns WEBP_MUX_NOT_FOUND if no such chunk exists; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxSetImage
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxSetImage(WebPMux* mux, const WebPData* bitstream, int copy_data);
functions.description: Sets a single (non-animated) image in the mux from a raw VP8/VP8L bitstream or a single-image WebP file. Replaces and removes any existing images/frames.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
bitstream must not be NULL and must contain a raw VP8/VP8L bitstream or a single-image (non-animated) WebP file.
copy_data = 1 to copy; 0 to reference. If not copied, the data must remain valid until WebPMuxAssemble() is called.
Returns WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_MEMORY_ERROR on allocation failure; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxPushFrame
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxPushFrame(WebPMux* mux, const WebPMuxFrameInfo* frame, int copy_data);
functions.description: Appends an animation frame (ANMF) to the mux. For non-animated images, use WebPMuxSetImage() instead.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
frame must not be NULL and must be valid: frame->id should be WEBP_CHUNK_ANMF; its bitstream must represent the frame image.
All pushed frames in a mux must have the same type (consistent with existing frames).
Odd x/y offsets will be snapped to even values (offset &= ~1).
copy_data = 1 to copy frame data; 0 to reference. If not copied, the frame data must remain valid until WebPMuxAssemble() is called.
Returns WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT if mux/frame is NULL or frame content is invalid; WEBP_MUX_MEMORY_ERROR on allocation failure; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxGetFrame
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxGetFrame(const WebPMux* mux, uint32_t nth, WebPMuxFrameInfo* frame);
functions.description: Retrieves the nth frame (1-based; nth=0 means last) from the mux. The frame bitstream is allocated for the caller and must be freed by the caller.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
frame must not be NULL; on success, frame->bitstream is allocated using WebPMalloc() and MUST be released with WebPDataClear() by the caller.
nth specifies which frame to retrieve; nth=0 selects the last frame.
Returns WEBP_MUX_NOT_FOUND if fewer than nth frames exist; WEBP_MUX_BAD_DATA if the stored frame chunk is invalid; WEBP_MUX_MEMORY_ERROR on allocation failure; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxDeleteFrame
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxDeleteFrame(WebPMux* mux, uint32_t nth);
functions.description: Deletes the nth frame (1-based; nth=0 means last) from the mux.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
nth indicates which frame to delete; nth=0 selects the last frame.
Returns WEBP_MUX_NOT_FOUND if fewer than nth frames exist before deletion; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT if mux is NULL; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxSetAnimationParams
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxSetAnimationParams(WebPMux* mux, const WebPMuxAnimParams* params);
functions.description: Sets animation (ANIM) parameters (background color and loop count) in the mux, replacing any existing ANIM chunk.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
params must not be NULL and should contain desired bgcolor (ARGB in MSB order) and loop_count (0 = infinite).
Returns WEBP_MUX_MEMORY_ERROR on allocation failure; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxGetAnimationParams
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxGetAnimationParams(const WebPMux* mux, WebPMuxAnimParams* params);
functions.description: Retrieves animation (ANIM) parameters from the mux.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
params must not be NULL and will be filled on success.
Returns WEBP_MUX_NOT_FOUND if no ANIM chunk is present; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxSetCanvasSize
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxSetCanvasSize(WebPMux* mux, int width, int height);
functions.description: Sets an explicit canvas width and height for the mux. If set, subsequent WebPMuxAssemble() enforces that all frames fit within the canvas; otherwise, canvas is derived from the frame bounding box during assemble.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
width and height must be within valid bounds for WebP (exact limits not specified in this header).
Returns WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT if mux is NULL or if width/height are invalid/out of bounds; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxGetCanvasSize
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxGetCanvasSize(const WebPMux* mux, int* width, int* height);
functions.description: Gets the canvas size from the mux. Assumes VP8X (if present) is up-to-date, i.e., the mux hasn’t been modified since the last WebPMuxAssemble() or WebPMuxCreate().
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
width and height must not be NULL.
Should only be called when the VP8X chunk (if present) is up-to-date: after WebPMuxAssemble() or WebPMuxCreate() and without modifications since.
Returns WEBP_MUX_BAD_DATA if VP8X/VP8/VP8L chunk or canvas size is invalid; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxGetFeatures
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxGetFeatures(const WebPMux* mux, uint32_t* flags);
functions.description: Retrieves feature flags from the mux (OR of WebPFeatureFlags values). Assumes VP8X (if present) is up-to-date.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
flags must not be NULL and will be filled on success.
Should be called only when VP8X is up-to-date: after WebPMuxAssemble() or WebPMuxCreate() and without modifications since.
Returns WEBP_MUX_BAD_DATA if VP8X/VP8/VP8L or canvas size is invalid; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxNumChunks
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxNumChunks(const WebPMux* mux, WebPChunkId id, int* num_elements);
functions.description: Returns the number of chunks of a given type present in the mux.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
num_elements must not be NULL and will be set on success.
id specifies the chunk type to count.
Returns WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPMuxAssemble
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPMuxAssemble(WebPMux* mux, WebPData* assembled_data);
functions.description: Validates the mux object and assembles all chunks into a single WebP RIFF bitstream stored in assembled_data. Overwrites any existing contents of assembled_data.
requirements: mux must not be NULL.
assembled_data must not be NULL. Its contents will be ignored and overwritten.
On success, assembled_data is allocated using WebPMalloc(); the caller MUST deallocate it using WebPDataClear(). It is safe to call WebPDataClear() even on error.
Returns WEBP_MUX_BAD_DATA for invalid mux; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_MEMORY_ERROR on allocation failure; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderOptionsInitInternal
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN int WebPAnimEncoderOptionsInitInternal(WebPAnimEncoderOptions*, int);
functions.description: Internal, version-checked initializer for WebPAnimEncoderOptions. Prefer WebPAnimEncoderOptionsInit().
requirements: First parameter must be a valid, writable WebPAnimEncoderOptions*.
Second parameter must be the ABI/version (WEBP_MUX_ABI_VERSION).
Returns 0 (false) on version mismatch; non-zero (true) on success.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderOptionsInit
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE int WebPAnimEncoderOptionsInit(WebPAnimEncoderOptions* enc_options);
functions.description: Initializes a WebPAnimEncoderOptions structure to defaults. Must be called before using the options struct.
requirements: enc_options must not be NULL and must point to writable memory.
Returns false in case of version mismatch, otherwise true.
Must be successfully called before using enc_options with the encoder.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderNewInternal
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPAnimEncoder* WebPAnimEncoderNewInternal(int, int, const WebPAnimEncoderOptions*, int);
functions.description: Internal, version-checked constructor for a WebPAnimEncoder with specified canvas size and options. Prefer WebPAnimEncoderNew().
requirements: First two integers are canvas width and height.
Third parameter may be NULL to use default options, or a valid pointer to WebPAnimEncoderOptions.
Fourth parameter must be the ABI/version (WEBP_MUX_ABI_VERSION).
Returns NULL on memory allocation failure.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderNew
functions.signature: static WEBP_INLINE WebPAnimEncoder* WebPAnimEncoderNew(int width, int height, const WebPAnimEncoderOptions* enc_options);
functions.description: Creates and initializes a WebPAnimEncoder for a given canvas size and optional options.
requirements: width and height specify the canvas size.
enc_options may be NULL to use reasonable defaults, or must point to a previously initialized WebPAnimEncoderOptions.
Returns NULL on memory error; otherwise a valid encoder pointer.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderAdd
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPAnimEncoderAdd(WebPAnimEncoder* enc, struct WebPPicture* frame, int timestamp_ms, const struct WebPConfig* config);
functions.description: Optimizes, encodes, and adds a frame to the WebPAnimEncoder. The final call must have frame == NULL to signal end of frames and to set the duration of the last frame.
requirements: enc must not be NULL.
For adding a real frame: frame must not be NULL and must contain image data in ARGB or YUV(A). If in YUV(A), it will be converted to ARGB (with a small loss).
For the finalization call: frame must be NULL (indicates no more frames).
timestamp_ms must be in non-decreasing order relative to previous frames; the duration of a frame is computed as next_timestamp - this_timestamp.
config may be NULL to use defaults or must be a valid WebPConfig pointer.
On error, returns 0 (false) and frame->error_code is set appropriately (when frame is non-NULL). Returns non-zero (true) on success.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderAssemble
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPAnimEncoderAssemble(WebPAnimEncoder* enc, WebPData* webp_data);
functions.description: Assembles all frames added so far into a final WebP bitstream written to webp_data. If the last call to WebPAnimEncoderAdd did not use frame == NULL, the last frame’s duration will be estimated internally.
requirements: enc must not be NULL.
webp_data must not be NULL and will be filled with the generated bitstream on success.
Should be called after adding frames; ideally after a final WebPAnimEncoderAdd(..., frame=NULL, ...).
Returns non-zero on success; 0 on failure.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderGetError
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN const char* WebPAnimEncoderGetError(WebPAnimEncoder* enc);
functions.description: Returns a pointer to an error string describing the most recent error from enc, or an empty string if the last call succeeded. The returned string is owned by enc and is only valid until the next encoder call or deletion.
requirements: enc may be NULL; returns NULL if enc is NULL.
The returned pointer must not be freed by the caller.
The returned string becomes invalid after the next call to WebPAnimEncoderAdd(), WebPAnimEncoderAssemble(), or WebPAnimEncoderDelete().

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderDelete
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN void WebPAnimEncoderDelete(WebPAnimEncoder* enc);
functions.description: Deletes and frees a WebPAnimEncoder and its resources.
requirements: enc may be NULL (no effect).
After calling, enc becomes invalid and must not be used.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderSetChunk
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPAnimEncoderSetChunk(WebPAnimEncoder* enc, const char fourcc[4], const WebPData* chunk_data, int copy_data);
functions.description: Adds or replaces a non-image chunk (e.g., ICCP, XMP, EXIF) to be included in the final animated WebP bitstream. Existing chunks with the same fourcc are removed first.
requirements: enc must not be NULL.
fourcc must not be NULL.
chunk_data must not be NULL and must contain the chunk payload.
copy_data = 1 to copy the chunk data; 0 to reference it. If not copied, the data must remain valid until WebPAnimEncoderAssemble() is called.
Returns WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_MEMORY_ERROR on allocation failure; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderGetChunk
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPAnimEncoderGetChunk(const WebPAnimEncoder* enc, const char fourcc[4], WebPData* chunk_data);
functions.description: Retrieves a reference to a non-image chunk’s data (by fourcc) from the encoder. The returned data is owned by the encoder and must not be freed by the caller.
requirements: enc must not be NULL.
fourcc must not be NULL.
chunk_data must not be NULL and will be filled on success.
Returns WEBP_MUX_NOT_FOUND if the chunk is absent; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPAnimEncoderDeleteChunk
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN WebPMuxError WebPAnimEncoderDeleteChunk(WebPAnimEncoder* enc, const char fourcc[4]);
functions.description: Deletes a non-image chunk (by fourcc) previously set on the encoder.
requirements: enc must not be NULL.
fourcc must not be NULL.
Returns WEBP_MUX_NOT_FOUND if the chunk is not present; WEBP_MUX_INVALID_ARGUMENT on bad inputs; WEBP_MUX_OK on success.

functions.name: WebPGetDemuxVersion
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN int WebPGetDemuxVersion(void);
functions.description: Returns the demux library version as 0xMMNNRR (major/minor/revision). Typical use is for logging or compatibility checks.
requirements: None beyond providing a valid call site; no inputs.

functions.name: WebPDemuxInternal
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN WebPDemuxer* WebPDemuxInternal(const WebPData*, int, WebPDemuxState*, int);
functions.description: Internal, version-checked constructor for a WebPDemuxer. The second int selects full (0) vs partial (1) parsing; the last int is the ABI version for compatibility checking. The demuxer keeps internal pointers to the provided WebPData.
requirements: The last int (ABI version) must match WEBP_DEMUX_ABI_VERSION.
The WebPData pointer must remain valid and unchanged for the lifetime of the returned WebPDemuxer.
If a non-NULL WebPDemuxState* is provided, caller must be prepared to read the reported state.
Caller must delete the returned WebPDemuxer with WebPDemuxDelete().

functions.name: WebPDemux
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE WebPDemuxer* WebPDemux(const WebPData* data);
functions.description: Parses a complete WebP file and returns a WebPDemuxer on success, or NULL on failure. Convenience wrapper over WebPDemuxInternal for full parsing.
requirements: data must point to the full WebP bitstream (for single images, file or chunk headers may be absent per format rules).
The memory referenced by data must persist and remain unchanged for the lifetime of the returned WebPDemuxer.
The returned WebPDemuxer must be freed with WebPDemuxDelete().

functions.name: WebPDemuxPartial
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD static WEBP_INLINE WebPDemuxer* WebPDemuxPartial(const WebPData* data, WebPDemuxState* state);
functions.description: Parses a possibly incomplete WebP bitstream. On success returns a WebPDemuxer and optionally reports parsing state via 'state'. On error or insufficient data to start parsing, returns NULL. The demuxer keeps pointers into 'data'.
requirements: data must remain valid and unchanged for the lifetime of the returned WebPDemuxer.
If 'state' is non-NULL, caller must read it to learn parsing progress (values > WEBP_DEMUX_PARSING_HEADER indicate valid feature values).
If input data is volatile/increasing, delete the demuxer and call WebPDemuxPartial() again with updated data.
The returned WebPDemuxer must be freed with WebPDemuxDelete().

functions.name: WebPDemuxDelete
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN void WebPDemuxDelete(WebPDemuxer* dmux);
functions.description: Frees all memory associated with a WebPDemuxer.
requirements: All active WebPIterator and WebPChunkIterator instances associated with dmux must be released via WebPDemuxReleaseIterator/WebPDemuxReleaseChunkIterator before calling.
dmux must be a valid WebPDemuxer returned by the demux API or NULL.

functions.name: WebPDemuxGetI
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN uint32_t WebPDemuxGetI(const WebPDemuxer* dmux, WebPFormatFeature feature);
functions.description: Returns a format/global feature value from a demuxer. Supported features include format flags, canvas size, loop count, background color, and frame count. For animated features, values are meaningful only for animated streams.
requirements: dmux must not be NULL.
Values are valid only if created via WebPDemux() or if WebPDemuxPartial() returned a state > WEBP_DEMUX_PARSING_HEADER.
If feature is WEBP_FF_FORMAT_FLAGS, caller should interpret the result as a bitwise OR of WebPFeatureFlags.
If feature is WEBP_FF_LOOP_COUNT or WEBP_FF_BACKGROUND_COLOR, the result is only meaningful for animated bitstreams.

functions.name: WebPDemuxGetFrame
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPDemuxGetFrame(const WebPDemuxer* dmux, int frame_number, WebPIterator* iter);
functions.description: Initializes a WebPIterator to point to the specified frame. On success, iter->fragment references the frame payload and other frame properties are populated. frame_number==0 selects the last frame.
requirements: dmux must not be NULL and must outlive the iterator; dmux must persist for the lifetime of iter.
iter must be non-NULL and will be initialized by this call; release it with WebPDemuxReleaseIterator() when done.
frame_number must be >= 0; 0 selects the last frame; positive values select that 1-based index.
Call WebPDemuxReleaseIterator() before any calls to WebPDemuxGetChunk() on the same iter and before destroying dmux.

functions.name: WebPDemuxNextFrame
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPDemuxNextFrame(WebPIterator* iter);
functions.description: Advances an initialized WebPIterator to the next frame (frame_num + 1). Does not loop. Returns true on success.
requirements: iter must be a valid iterator previously initialized by WebPDemuxGetFrame().
There must exist a next frame; otherwise returns false.
Do not expect wrap-around/looping semantics.

functions.name: WebPDemuxPrevFrame
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPDemuxPrevFrame(WebPIterator* iter);
functions.description: Moves an initialized WebPIterator to the previous frame (frame_num - 1). Does not loop. Returns true on success.
requirements: iter must be a valid iterator previously initialized by WebPDemuxGetFrame().
There must exist a previous frame; otherwise returns false.
Do not expect wrap-around/looping semantics.

functions.name: WebPDemuxReleaseIterator
functions.signature: WEBP_EXTERN void WebPDemuxReleaseIterator(WebPIterator* iter);
functions.description: Releases any resources attached to a WebPIterator. Must be called after iteration is complete.
requirements: Must be called before any subsequent calls to WebPDemuxGetChunk() on the same iterator.
Must be called before destroying the associated WebPDemuxer with WebPDemuxDelete().
iter must be a WebPIterator previously obtained from WebPDemuxGetFrame() (NULL is permitted and is a no-op by convention, though not explicitly stated).

functions.name: WebPDemuxGetChunk
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPDemuxGetChunk(const WebPDemuxer* dmux, const char fourcc[4], int chunk_number, WebPChunkIterator* iter);
functions.description: Initializes a WebPChunkIterator to the specified chunk instance identified by a 4-character fourcc (e.g., "ICCP", "EXIF", "XMP "). chunk_number==0 selects the last such chunk. On success, iter->chunk references the payload.
requirements: dmux must not be NULL and must persist for the lifetime of the iterator.
fourcc must name a 4-character chunk identifier (array of 4 chars).
chunk_number must be >= 0; 0 selects the last chunk in the set; positive values select that 1-based index.
iter must be non-NULL and will be initialized by this call; release it with WebPDemuxReleaseChunkIterator() when done.
Image-related payloads should be accessed via WebPDemuxGetFrame() and related APIs, not via this function.

functions.name: WebPDemuxNextChunk
functions.signature: WEBP_NODISCARD WEBP_EXTERN int WebPDemuxNextChunk(WebPChunkIterator* iter);

functions.description: Creates and initializes a WebPAnimDecoder for (possibly animated) WebP. If dec_options is NULL, reasonable defaults are used (color mode defaults to MODE_RGBA). Returns NULL on parsing error, invalid option, or memory error.
requirements: webp_data must point to a WebP bitstream that remains unchanged for the lifetime of the decoder.
dec_options can be NULL; if non-NULL, it should be initialized with WebPAnimDecoderOptionsInit and use only supported color modes (MODE_RGBA, MODE_BGRA, MODE_rgbA, MODE_bgrA).
